design.title: Design
design.intro: Choose how the app looks on this device. It changes the office, the courier app, the tracking page and sign-in. The data stays the same.
design.perDevice: The choice is kept in this browser. On a phone, change it from the courier's account.

about.dispecerat: Blue bar on top, dense table, amber for the main action.
about.kraft: Label white, kraft board, blue stamp ink. The day grouped by courier.
about.semnal: Signal yellow and black. Large stage counts that filter the table.
about.verde: Green and white, larger text, roomy. Starts with the to-do list.
about.tactil: One raised sheet, buttons with depth, couriers by the hour above the table.
about.aer: A grouped list under floating frosted controls, black pill buttons.
about.expres: Start from the courier and see their day stop by stop. One orange button.
about.insula: Apple iOS 26 language. A Dynamic Island with the live day, a floating glass tab bar, couriers as Live Activities, activity rings, springs.
about.radar: Live operations. The day drawn as a radar around the depot: every parcel at its real direction and distance, couriers' runs as lines, a floating dock for the menu.
about.triaj: A keyboard-first tool, like Linear. An inbox of what needs doing with the chosen item in full beside it; J/K, Enter, C, A, R, and ⌘K for everything else.
about.val: Google's Material 3 Expressive. Green tonal surfaces, a navigation rail with a FAB, wavy progress, shapes that morph, a button group that changes shape when pressed.

design.round2Intro: Designs with nothing in common: layout, type, colour, icons, menu and motion are each their own. The previews are the live app.
